observations: The page number «27» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature «4*» on the right. L01-L04 end chapter 33 (p. 26, JP2 0058).

L05: a second account of the lunar eclipse begins with a run-in heading in bold, «[Scientia examinationis lunarium defectuum.», opening a passage in square brackets that does not close on this page. L07: the vertical bar between «latitudinis» and «ad» marks the beginning of fol. 45 recto of N, which the note in the right margin, «N 45r», names; transcribed as a margin note.

The Arabic terms in italics: «elmuht» and «elmuth» (al-mukth, the duration of totality), the editor's «(sic)» upright with «sic» in italics (L11, L22), «elciicuth» and «elszukut» (al-suqūṭ, the immersion), «liwacat elcuzuf» (li-waqt al-kusūf, for the time of the eclipse). N09: «wakhod mebibelche», the corrupt Arabic of C that Suter discusses on p. XXII (JP2 0026, L17-L22); N09-N10 «elfudhul» (al-fuḍūl, the differences).

L23-L28: the half-duration of the immersion and of the totality: the minutes of arc increased by half their sixth, a twelfth, divided by the moon's hourly motion, give the hours. Checked: the moon gains on the sun at about 0;30,28 degrees an hour (0;32,56 less the sun's 0;2,28) against its own 0;32,56, so that the arc divided by the relative motion is 1.081 times the arc divided by the moon's motion; adding a twelfth gives 1.083.

L13: the i of the last word, «si», is a bold sort, heavier than the s; transcribed «si». L10: a small dark speck below the line after «atque»; not transcribed. N04-N05: no dash stands between note 9, at the end of N04, and note 10, at the beginning of N05. N07: the bracket after the note number 15 is printed broken in the middle.
The semicolons of the text and the colon of N12 stand after the thin space of the edition (11-14 px measured).
